name: Famine
value: Risk of Famine in Sudan; none newly confirmed
summary: IPC committee warns famine risk is rising in Darfur and Kordofan; no area newly classified as Famine found as of 21 Nov
state: The IPC Famine Review Committee said on 12 Oct that famine risk is rising in Greater Darfur and Greater Kordofan as drought compounds the war, but there was not enough survey data for a full classification (UN News via AllAfrica). WFP said in October that funding cuts had halved rations in Gaza, where about 200,000 people are in IPC Phase 4 (WFP). These are risk warnings, not a new Famine classification; searches on 21 Nov found none, so Watch holds.
for_you: People in besieged and drought-hit parts of Darfur and Kordofan face the greatest risk. A formal Famine finding usually follows new survey data and tends to bring UN appeals and access negotiations.
rubric_hit: Watch: IPC risk-of-famine alert for Darfur and Kordofan (12 Oct); no new Phase 5 classification found

sources.title: AllAfrica (UN News) — Sudan: Drought and war push Darfur and Kordofan towards famine
WFP — Funding cuts force WFP to drastically reduce lifesaving assistance in Gaza

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
rubric.watch: IPC Phase 5 projected or 'risk of famine' alerts.
rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
